title: Removable singularities of Yang-Mills-Higgs fields in higher dimensions
summary: This paper establishes decay estimates near isolated singularities for $n$-dimensional Yang-Mills-Higgs fields defined on a fiber bundle ($n \geq 4$). These estimates yield a removable singularity theorem for Yang-Mills-Higgs fields under conformally invariant energy bounds, extending the classical results for Yang-Mills fields and harmonic maps.
